name: Build a Tycoon!
desc:
Buy spots to place down structures, build droppers and upgraders, rebirth for benefits, and beat the obbies for boosts!

Join the group to get a 1.2x money boost!

Premium players get a 1.2x money boost!

If you have any suggestions or have found bugs, please say in the group wall.

If you enjoyed please like and/or favorite!
